name: Hydrology
description: Water mechanics built for Earth's rivers: channel filling, smoother drops, rapids, deep canals and working mill races. Includes Earth river-flow and water-wheel integration and a per-world Water flooding option. Standalone gameplay outside Earth has not been tested for this release. Bucket source transport follows vanilla settings; enabling Prevent liquid source transport by buckets is strongly recommended. Vanilla blocks only. Not compatible with Realistic Water or Realistic Rapids.
